snippet.title: Phy
snippet.description:
League of Legends videos to help you climb, learn, laugh and stay one step ahead!

What I use to make my videos:
Recording Footage - OBS
Editing - Sony Vegas
Sound - Audacity
Mic - Shure SM7B

PC specs - https://ironsidecomputers.com/
Nemesis Ultra Case: Nemesis 
Case V2 -White   
Internal Lighting: Ironside RGB LED Strip
Wiring: Advanced Pro Wiring -Individually Sleeved Cables (Cerulean Blue)

CPU Cooling: Corsair Hydro H60 Liquid Cooling 
Motherboard: Z390 Chipset Motherboard 
Memory: G.Skill Trident Z32GB (4x8GB) DDR4 [RGB] 
Primary Hard Drive: 500GB Ironside Certified SSD 
Secondary Hard Drive: 2TB 
Graphics Card: GeForce RTX 2080 8GB
Power Supply: 700 Watt 80 Plus 
Networking: Internal Wireless N 300Mbps
